purpose: Minimal routing fixtures for scaffold-audit. These fixtures protect owner selection before any skill deletion or router merge.

fixtures.task: Find where a cross-surface ARIA-NBV symbol or document owner lives.
non_goals: Do not use KG as the default source of truth for a localized lookup.

fixtures.task: Check an advisor-facing thesis or literature claim against source-backed evidence.
non_goals: Do not promote retrieved evidence without inspecting canonical sources.

fixtures.task: Change target-specific RRI labels, GT OBB crop support, target validity reasons, or target-conditioned VIN fields.
non_goals: Do not route target/RRI implementation ownership through the generic context router.

fixtures.task: Change pose, camera, coordinate-frame, CW90, PyTorch3D projection, depth backprojection, or candidate-frustum contracts.
non_goals: Do not route geometry contract changes through entity-aware RRI unless target crop semantics are touched.

fixtures.task: Create an advisor-facing conceptual plan for a PyTorch3D camera convention change with external API evidence.
non_goals: Do not let Context7 replace local geometry owners or the nbv-geometry-contracts evidence loop.

fixtures.task: Find the source family and thesis target-RRI section owner for a local wording check.
non_goals: Do not use KG, Context7, or external library docs for local source family lookup.

fixtures.task: Check an advisor-facing finite-candidate Double-Q literature claim against source-backed evidence.
non_goals: Do not promote retrieved literature evidence without inspecting Quarto, BibTeX, and source-order owners.

fixtures.task: Locate the local literature source family for a narrow VIN-NBV methods claim before writing thesis prose.
non_goals: Do not use KG as the default owner for deterministic local source family discovery.

fixtures.task: Locate the implementation of candidate frustum rendering with source family and code-index evidence.
non_goals: Do not start with browser tools or KG when local code-index and rg can localize the source.

fixtures.task: Place planned but unimplemented target-RRI, rollout, or Q_H research details in canonical thesis or Quarto owners.
non_goals: Do not store planned implementation detail in a skill body.

fixtures.task: Localize the nearest aria_nbv package AGENTS.md owner before changing Python API contracts or generated implementation docs.
non_goals: Do not store package API contract detail in a skill body.

fixtures.task: Simplify scaffold skills by reviewing skill bodies for duplicated formulas, roadmap claims, future-work plans, or implementation contracts.
non_goals: Do not merge or delete a skill before replacement-owner evidence and routing fixtures pass.

fixtures.task: Diagnose a failing command, traceback, suspicious metric, or bad runtime output.
non_goals: Do not patch by guesswork before a reproducer or explicit blocker exists.

fixtures.task: Review ARIA-NBV working-tree or PR diffs and produce severity-ranked findings.
non_goals: Do not substitute a generic review harness for ARIA-NBV domain routing.

fixtures.task: Write or refactor docstrings for Python public API contracts.
non_goals: Do not remove the docstring skill until its rules are migrated and routing fixtures still pass.

fixtures.task: Edit Typst thesis prose, shared notation, citations, figures, or rendered-page QA.
non_goals: Do not route pure Quarto navigation work through Typst authoring.

fixtures.task: Plan a Quarto literature navigation cleanup with local bibliography and source-order evidence.
non_goals: Do not route docs literature planning through diagnose-aria live browser app diagnosis.

fixtures.task: Polish Typst thesis prose and citations without changing Python implementation code.
non_goals: Do not use simplification Python analyzer tools for pure Typst prose and citation edits.

fixtures.task: Prune or simplify scaffold skills, metadata, or references while preserving behavior.
non_goals: Do not delete or merge skills without replacement-owner evidence.
